answer: Meteg probably present: a short vertical stroke next to the tsere under מ (מֵֽ), i.e. host letter מ with tsere. No other meteg seen in the word.
visible_evidence: The whole word וּמֵאַחֲרֵינוּ and the vowel points under it are visible: tsere under מ, patah under א, hataf patah under ח, and tsere under ר. A short vertical stroke sits beside the tsere under מ, at the right end of the row of points. It is not part of the hataf patah, and no ink from a neighbouring line touches it. In this enlargement the stroke seems to sit to the right of the tsere rather than in the usual left position, so I can't be sure whether it belongs to מ or to the וּ before it. I'm confident a stroke is there, but less sure which letter it belongs to. I saw no other meteg stroke under א, ח, ר or נ.
